description_en: Retrieves information about URL-based upload jobs
name: GetURLUploadInfos

parameters.description_en:
A list of upload job IDs. A JobId is the value of the JobId parameter returned when you call the [UploadMediaByURL](~~86311~~) operation.

- You can specify up to 10 IDs.

- Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

> You must specify either JobIds or UploadURLs. If you specify both, only JobIds is processed.
parameters.description_zh:
上传任务ID（JobId）列表。由一个或多个JobId组成，JobId为通过[UploadMediaByURL](~~86311~~)接口上传时，返回参数JobId的值。
- 最多支持10个ID。
- 多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> JobIds和UploadURLs必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds。

parameters.description_en:
A list of source video file URLs. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 URLs.

> - URL-encode the URLs before you use them.
>
> - If a video from the same URL is uploaded multiple times, specify a single URL for the query.
>
> - You must specify either JobIds or UploadURLs. If you specify both, only JobIds is processed.
parameters.description_zh:

> - 使用前，先进行URL编码。
> - 如果同一URL视频多次上传，建议传入单个URL进行查询。
> - JobIds和UploadURLs必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds。
